title: Planner: save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat
summary: The roadmap details and the existing Planner Agent access commands are supported. However, the briefing promises that existing chat users will receive saved filters without action even though Microsoft has not stated the default; it also assumes undocumented details about saved-filter data and interpretation.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to let users save AI-generated filters from Planner Agent chat for future use on their plans.
claims.quote: Planner: Save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat; Save AI-filters generated by the Planner Agent for future use on your plans.

claims.where: Why it matters: If nobody acts
claims.claim: If nobody acts, users who already have Planner Agent chat will be able to save filters when the feature arrives.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner Agent" "saved filters" "default" "rollout"; opened https://learn.microsoft.com/planner/turn-off-planner-agent and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/release-notes; neither these nor the roadmap states automatic saved-filter availability.
claims.fix: Replace this sentence with: 'Microsoft has not stated whether saved filters will become available automatically to users who already have Planner Agent chat.' Keep the defaultState field unknown and the corresponding open question.

claims.claim: A saved filter is built from plan content the user can already reach through Planner Agent chat.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner Agent chat" "permissions" "plan"; "Planner Agent" "saved filters" "identity" "permissions" "data"; opened https://learn.microsoft.com/planner/turn-off-planner-agent; it describes plan summaries, not saved-filter data inputs or permissions.
claims.fix: Replace the assertion in Data exposure and the risk rationale with the roadmap-supported fact that this saves AI-generated filters for reuse on plans. Say that the saved-filter data inputs and permission behavior are not yet documented rather than asserting them.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes saving filters for plans, not agent actions on tasks.
claims.quote: Save AI-filters generated by the Planner Agent for future use on your plans.

claims.where: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Saved-filter results depend on the agent's interpretation of the request.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner" "filter" "interpretation" "agent"; "Planner Agent" "filters" "save"; opened https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/release-notes and https://learn.microsoft.com/planner/turn-off-planner-agent; no saved-filter execution semantics found.
claims.fix: Remove 'because an AI-generated filter is interpreted by the agent' and 'results depend on the agent's interpretation of the request'. Retain the explicitly qualified statement that behavior when plan data changes is not documented and the advice to collect unexpected-result reports.
